name: Black Box
tagline: A crash investigator for AI agents
track: 02 The Agent That Can Explain Why
user: The on-call engineer or ops lead paged because an AI agent did something expensive
problem: When a production AI agent misbehaves, nobody can say why with evidence, and the fix is a prompt patch nobody has tested against the failure

sponsors.zetaris: Every evidence query runs through the Zetaris REST API across three registered sources (Postgres datasource, JSON and CSV filestore tables), including cross-source joins.
sponsors.meterless: World Model engine: event-sourced flight recorder with a point-in-time policy fold, and the store of signed guardrails. H-MEM engine: memory of signed findings with provenance. Nightshift Runtime: the primary AI provider (OpenAI-compatible, 127.0.0.1:8088).
sponsors.nvidia: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning through Nightshift runs the refund agent, Root-Cause, Skeptic and Counterpart; its token budget is the visible thinking budget, raised on refutation.
sponsors.cursor: Not used: Cursor became optional on 22 Oct (HackOS announcement); built with Claude Code.

reproducible: npm run setup && npm run demo:check -- --replay (recordings of the last live run in data/recordings/)
_note: Field names are provisional until checked against the HackOS Submission Form Preview.
